scope: Delaunator comparison using projected coordinates and index triples captured in separate native previews for the convex control.
observations: Face 0 matches 7 of 9 native index triples; face 1 matches all 9. On face 0, the remaining four points at indices 3, 4, 6, 7 are exactly cocircular: the rational incircle determinant is zero. Delaunator chooses diagonal (4,6), native chooses (3,7).
limitations: Input and output were recorded in separate previews; prior exported-facet comparison corroborates this case only.
One matching Delaunay control does not establish native Delaunay implementation or general tie rules.
No production change or GUI/MCP acceptance is claimed.
